title: Zoology: Ecology & Environment Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Ecology & Environment Chapter

cards.q: Who is known as the Father of Ecology?
Who is known as the Father of Indian Ecology?
Who introduced the term 'Ecosystem' and in what year?
According to Lindeman's 10% Law (1942), what happens to energy in a food chain?
cards.a: Only 10% of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next.

cards.q: What type of ecosystem is a pond or lake classified as?
What is the specific homopolymer name of the bioplastic produced by the microorganism Alcaligenes?
Which bacteria is used to demolish microorganisms in domestic waste water?
Which device is 99% effective in reducing serious smoke nuisances and attracting particles emitted by power plants?
When and where was the Ozone Hole first discovered?
cards.a: 1984 in Antarctica (coined by Shaan Bean / discovered by NASA).
